ec.name: Ukuhlola ikhodi yamandla
ec.notice: Umhlahlandlela somdwebi, hhayi umbhalo wokuthobela. Iqhathanisa okuchazwe nguwe nephakheji elibhaliwe yekhodi kanye nobuncane obunqunyiwe. Akukhiqizi isitifiketi sokuthobela, futhi ihlola udonga lwesakhiwo kuphela. Igxathu lezamandla nomnyango wezakhiwo ngabo abanquma ukuthi kuyathobela.

ec.cbecc.what: Ilondoloza izakhiwo zangaphandle njengefayela lephrojekthi (.ribd25) ye-{program}, uhlelo lokuthobela lweKhomishini Yamandla, ukuze igxathu lezamandla liqale kumodeli yakho hhayi kwifomu elingenalutho: isifunda sezulu, indawo yephansi enohlelo lomoya, wonke amadonga angaphandle ngokuqondiswa ayibheke ngakho kanye namawindi neminyango yawo, uphahla, ikamelo lophahla, iphansi nokwakhiwa kwawo.
ec.cbecc.assumed: Ifayela lichaza lezi zinto ezingakaze zitshelwe: hlola ngayinye ohlelweni:
ec.cbecc.left: Akukho kwefayela, igxathu lezamandla kumele likungeze ohlelweni:
ec.cbecc.proof: Ukuqinisekiswa kwalokhu: yonke into, impahla kanye negama elisefayeleni kuhlolwa ngemodeli yedatha yohlelo ePapashiwe, futhi lokhu kuhlola kudlula izindlu eziyizibonelo ezingu-24 zeKhomishini. Asikakavulwa ifayela ohlelweni ngokwalo. Yisisekelo sefayela, hhayi umphumela wokuthobela.
ec.cbecc.saved: {name} ilondoloziwe. Yivule ohlelweni, engeza izinhlelo, bese uhlola okuthathwe yifayela.
ec.cbecc.miss.zone: Isifunda sezulu: thayipha i-ZIP code yesayithi.
ec.cbecc.miss.walls: Izindonga zangaphandle zohlobo lodonga lwangaphandle emodelini.
ec.cbecc.miss.north: Inyakatho yangempela: isayithi lemodeli lidinga ubude nobubanzi.
ec.cbecc.miss.wall-insulation: Ngohlobo ngalunye lodonga lwangaphandle: usayizi wamapharele nokungaphakathi kwawo.
ec.cbecc.miss.wall-words: Udonga okungenagama ohlelweni lwamapharele noma insulation yalo.
ec.cbecc.miss.ceiling-kind: Kuphela ikamelo lophahla elinomoya nezipayipi esikhaleni esilawulwayo (Ukukhetha C) lingabhalwa okwamanje.
ec.cbecc.miss.ceiling-r: Insulation yeleyini, njenge-R-value ephelele ohlelo olulandisa.
ec.cbecc.miss.floor-r: Insulation yephansi, njenge-R-value ephelele ohlelo olulandisa.
ec.cbecc.miss.perimeter: Ubude bezindonga zangaphandle zeleveli ephansi kakhulu.
ec.cbecc.as.footprint: Izindawo zeleyini nephansi ziyindawo yephansi ehlukaniswe ngenani lamaleveli.
ec.cbecc.as.crawl-height: Izindonga zesikhala sokuhamba zingu-2 ft ubude, nephansi lingu-2 ft ngaphezu komhlaba.
ec.cbecc.as.floor-joists: Izinkanyezi zephansi ziyi-2x6 ku-16 in. ngokumaphakathi.
ec.cbecc.as.slab-surface: Isilabhu sinesembozo sohlelo esizenzakalelayo futhi asinayo insulation yomphetho.
ec.cbecc.as.roofing: Ukwezela kophahla kungamashingili e-asphalt phezu kwesiqandisi sokhuni phezu kwezinsika ezingu-24 in.
ec.cbecc.as.wall-finish: Ukuqeda kwezindonga zangaphandle kungu-siding (uhlobo lodonga oluthiwe ngokuthi stucco lubhalwa njenge-stucco yezingqimba ezintathu).
ec.cbecc.left.systems: Ukushisa, ukupholisa, izipayipi, ukushisisa amanzi nokungena komoya.
ec.cbecc.left.garage: Igalaji, uma likhona, nezindonga phakathi kwalo nendlu.
ec.cbecc.left.shading: Okuphuma kophahla, amaphiko nokunye ukufiphaza kwamawindi.
ec.cbecc.left.run: Ikheli lesitaladi, izilungiselelo zokusebenza nezinketho zombiko.
ec.cbecc.view: Leli fayela libamba izindawo nokuqondiswa, hhayi izimo, ngakho umbukeli wemodeli awukwazi ukulidweba, nemibukeli eyenzelwe amafayela alolu hlelo angewezakhiwo ngeke ilivule. Ukuze ubukele le modeli njengesimo se-3D kumbukeli wangaphandle, londoloza ifayela le-EnergyPlus esikhundleni salokho: ithebhu yamandla, Hlola nge-EnergyPlus, Londoloza.
